The one thing that matters most

Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, its new top model, just two weeks after Gemini 4 Argon; it ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and leads on cybersecurity tests.

It goes to cyber defenders first, with wider access soon. Also big: ChatGPT Pro and Business subscribers now get up to $500 a month in OpenAI developer credits, and you can now text your ChatGPT dot.

Sundar Pichai@sundarpichai
I did say we'd be releasing our models periodically...introducing Gemini 4 Carbon, our next frontier model.

Following Argon's release just two weeks ago, Carbon shows the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier, it ranks #1 on the recently updated v5.0 of @ArtificialAnlys Intelligence Index at 59. It also leads across key cybersecurity evaluations scoring 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for finding vulnerabilities, 54.8% on ExploitGym for exploitation, and 71.0% on CWE-bench for patching.

We’re seeing significant improvements in long-horizon tasks even compared to Argon, and we’ve strengthened frontier safeguards.

As we did with Argon, we’re going to roll it out gradually + responsibly. Some trusted cyber defenders will get access starting this week. We'll be expanding it to more partners through our Fairwind Program, ahead of wider availability soon, so hang tight!

Rime launched Prism, a voice model for phone agents that writes each reply as text first, so companies can edit or block what the agent says.

Rime has launched Prism, its new speech-to-speech model for AI voice agents that writes each reply as text before saying it out loud.

Companies can edit the transcript and block anything the agent shouldn't say, while Prism keeps the call going and looks up an account or freezes a card mid-conversation.

Rime says no other speech-to-speech model works this way, which makes Prism a safer fit for banks and other regulated businesses.

Exciting news: Gemini 4 Carbon (High) from @GoogleDeepMind just made a huge debut on Arena, landing #1 in Text Arena, #2 in Agent Arena, and #4 in Code Arena: WebDev. Back at the top, Gemini 4 Carbon delivers frontier intelligence and reshapes the Pareto frontier across three arenas.

In Agent Arena, Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #2 with a +16.2% net improvement across +21.9K real-world agentic sessions from our global community, surpassing top models GPT-6 Astra and Fable-5.1. At $1.80 median cost per task, Gemini 4 Carbon (High) costs 72% less than the #1 ranked Claude Opus 5.5 (Max).

Its standouts by key signals:
- #1 Steerability (+18.6%): can the model course-correct when you push back?
- #2 Praise vs Complaint (+37.9%): implicit sentiment in users' reactions
- #3 Confirmed Success (+18.7%): explicit “yes, that worked” from users

In Code Arena: WebDev, Carbon scored 1768 pts landing #4:
- Just 2 pts below #3 Claude Sonnet 5.5 (xHigh), at 1770 pts
- 89 pts above #11 Gemini 4 Argon (High), at 1679 pts

By category, it ranks #3 in Gaming and Simulations, and #5 in Brand & Marketing.

In Text Arena, Gemini 4 Carbon (High) is the new #1 with 1528 pts, now ahead of Gemini 4 Argon (High) at #2 with 1520 pts.

Andrew Benson@AndrewBenson· Oct 28
Who actually gets rich if Anthropic lists at $2 trillion?

The S-1 filed on Monday lets us answer from the filing itself.

The reported target is $1.5T to $2T, listing the week of November 16. The filing implies about 16.9B fully diluted shares. So $2T works out to roughly $118 a share.

The cap table at $2T:

- $199B for the 7 controlling co-founders, about 10%
- $28B for Ben Mann, if his stake matches theirs
- $100B for the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund, 5%
- $331B in employee options and RSUs, about 17% , That pool covers about 5,300 employees, an average of $62M each.
- But when you joined matters enormously.

The S-1 shows how much equity was granted each year, and at what price. [
Headcount went from about 300 to 500 in late 2023, to 940 at end 2024, to 5,300 now.

Match the two, and here is roughly how many people made what at $2T:

- $110M to $400M each: ~300 to 500 people hired by 2023
- $200M to $300M each: ~440 to 640 hired in 2024
- $70M to $95M each: ~1,360 hired in 2025
- $10M to $20M each: ~3,000 hired in 2026
So about 940 people hired by the end of 2024 average nine figures. Everyone hired since averages eight figures.

The 2024 class is the surprise. That year Anthropic granted 1.28B options at $1.30 a share. At $118, that one year of grants is worth about $133B.

Then there is the tender. In April, holders could sell at $25.91 a share. Investors lined up $6B, but only $4.7B sold.

Weeks later, Series H priced at $58.90 a share. At $2T, the people who held would be up 4.6x. And Dario and Daniela Amodei were among the sellers.

The 7 founders have pledged 80% of their equity to charity. That is about $159B at $2T. But the S-1 says the pledges are not legally binding.

New research model Cue lines up every character of a transcript with the audio more precisely than any other tool it tested, so captions land at the right moment.

ElevenLabs@ElevenLabs
New from ElevenLabs research: Today we’re sharing more about Cue, our new forced alignment model. It places every character on the audio timeline with more precision than any other aligner we tested. That means the right words show up at the right time.

Forced alignment is the step that turns a transcript into timestamps. It’s how subtitles land on time, how dubbed lines match the speaker, and how clicking a word in a transcript jumps to the moment it was said. Most open-source aligners are built for short, clean clips in a limited set of languages. Cue is one model that handles recordings of any length in a single pass. On real-world audio, it was more accurate than every open-source aligner we tested in all 29 languages of our benchmark. It aligns an hour of audio in about half a second on one GPU.

Cue already powers every Speech to Text transcription on ElevenLabs, and it’s available on its own through the Forced Alignment API.

🇺🇸 Donald Trump says a tanker with one million barrels of Venezuelan oil is "the first shipment of BILLIONS of Barrels to come" and that gas and diesel prices "will soon come plummeting down". He posted it on Truth Social on Tuesday, October 27, at 10:04 am PT, then repeated it at a rally at the Port of Corpus Christi, Texas. #Trump #TrumpNews #DonaldTrump #Venezuela

🗣️ What he said, per the Factbase rally transcript:

🛢️ On the cargo: "See that little ship out there? It's got one million barrels of oil on it from Venezuela." He said it will be refined in Texas, including in Corpus Christi. #Texas #CorpusChristi #VenezuelanOil

⛽ On fuel: "Gasoline and diesel prices will soon come down. They'll come plummeting down for the consumer." #Diesel #GasPrices

🌊 On Hormuz: "We're thinking about renaming it the Trump Strait. Should we do it?" A suggestion at the rally, not a policy. #Hormuz

🔍 The claims vs the reporting:

💬 In his post he said the oil comes at "NO cost to the American Taxpayer". KIII-TV noted this was not independently verified at the rally. #Geopolitics

🧾 The seller, North American Blue Energy Partners, says the first million barrels arrived on two tankers and were delivered at no cost. The Washington Post reports the US deal lets it buy part of the firm's crude at a deep discount, citing two people familiar with it, and that experts do not expect a big impact on US gas prices. #Shipping

📌 "Billions of barrels" is his own claim, not a confirmed figure. #News

🌍 The backdrop, per CNBC: Brent settled at 113.88 dollars and WTI at 99.90 dollars on Tuesday, both down for a second day on Middle East de-escalation talks. #Brent #WTI #OilPrices

👇 Why markets listen:

🛢️ Oil: new supply headlines can move crude, heavy grades and diesel spreads. #Oil #CrudeOil
